text:
zoe: All-hands going live! Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/401 — drop your tiny celebrations, memes, and hot takes :tada:
hamid: Present with a suspiciously triumphant office plant (Fern) that finally got repotted. applause please :herb:
rachel: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/plant-cheer — Fern is a mood
kai: Snack emergency: scallion pancakes or hobnobs? react :pancake: or :cookie:
mari: pancakes :pancake:
hamid: hobnobs :cookie:
zoe: shoutout to infra for the stealthy rollback earlier — silent heroes :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Recording will be posted to #all-hands after the meeting.
rachel: tiny new tradition: meme-bingo in chat. I dropped a bingo card in #random, join if you dare :bingo:
kai: question: is hot honey acceptable on office pizza? culinary opinions welcome.
mari: hot honey = yes forever
hamid: live demonstration of interpretive shadow puppets promised if we hit the metric. no refunds.
zoe: please mute unless providing shadow puppets or dramatic applause. exceptions: plant coaching.
rachel: parents and pets corner: hi from my goldfish, Gerald. He disapproves of metrics.
deploy-bot: Meeting recording started.
kai: post-show poll: "meme-bingo" or "quick-hang"? reply "bingo" or "hang"
mari: bingo
hamid: hang if there are real hobnobs
zoe: bingo AND hobnobs is the dream
rachel: emoji flood in 3...2...1 :tada: :clap: :cookie:
deploy-bot: Meeting will be auto-closed in 2 hours. Thanks for attending! :robot_face:
zoe: thanks all — love the energy. see you at Q&A and the possibly ill-advised shadow puppet encore :smile:
